meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为对话机器人装上长期记忆,支持本地或远程两种运行方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 助手记住跨会话的上下文却不知怎么搭记忆服务
copy.tagline_en: Give your chatbot long-term memory, run locally or remotely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to recall context across sessions but need help wiring up memory.

howto.what: 为 Grok Bot 装上 claude-mem:本地 worker 加 CMEM Pro 观察者,按 agent 监听会话记录,并在真实任务开始时注入上下文、写入 live INDEX 文件。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上配置 claude-mem 时触发;默认走 CMEM Pro,host 登录观察者与远端 cmem.ai 属于可选。不需要 Cursor。

say.text: 在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem,用默认的 CMEM Pro
改用 host 登录观察者再装一次

howto.what_en: Installs claude-mem for Grok Bot: a local worker plus the CMEM Pro observer that watches each agent's transcripts and injects session context into a live INDEX file.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot. CMEM Pro is the default; the host-login observer and remote cmem.ai are opt-in. No Cursor needed.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Grok Bot with the default CMEM Pro setup
Reinstall it using the host-login observer
say_en.note: Adds --provider host on a loopback port

say_en.text: Set up the remote version pointing at cmem.ai
